title: A walking Pokémon's entry: res/field/actors/pokemon/<code>/pokemon.json
description: The entry of ARCID_TPOKE's table (a/2/0/8, TPokeEntry in tpoke_data.c) for the object code whose directory it is in: the species, sex and form that GetPokemonFieldOBJCODE gives this code for, the first entry that fits in the order of generated/obj_codes.txt. tools/data/walking_pokemon_data.py packs them; a code without one is not in the table.

sex.description: The sex it is for, or null for either (TPOKE_SEX_ANY)
